verdict.rationale: Convex is a backend/database platform, not an agent, IDE, or assistant with its own tool-use runtime that could consume external MCP servers. All evidence (convex-docs-10, convex-probe-4, convex-probe-7) shows the reverse relationship: Convex ships an MCP *server* so external AI agents can call Convex's tools, not a client capability for Convex to plug in and use other MCP servers' tools.
